H1.statement: median normalised gap to best_known over held-out feasible goals <= 5%

H2.statement: surrogate-first matches or beats twin-only TPE and CMA-ES at 300 evaluations while using <= 1/5 of their twin CPU-seconds
H2.cost_caveat: surrogate-first twin CPU-seconds were not recorded (cost bug: only the twin-run count was kept). The measured twin-run ratio and an estimate (runs x the same goal's measured twin-only CPU-s per run) are both required to clear 1/5.

H3.statement: surrogate_only's verified objective is worse than surrogate-first's AND its mean surrogate-minus-twin profit gap on the chosen plan is positive

H4.statement: feasibility rate >= 90% on held-out feasible goals (point, on re-evaluation) AND the infeasible-by-design goal returns infeasible_unverified

verify_to_reeval.label: pre-registered quantities (feasibility on re-evaluation), cut by verification

twin_only_search_saw_feasible.label: search stream, 5 reps, best feasible score seen during search; None = never

novelty.label: computed and stored only; never read by ranking or selection; the optimiser defines no 'novel' flag
